reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isDailyWeekendSkip pipeline and adds one shared isWeekendOrHoliday predicate, instead of a parallel holiday mechanism.

duplication.why: The 'daily skip filter + move map' pattern already copied in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template is edited identically in each place to thread holidays, rather than folded into one occurrence-adjustment helper; two separate lookahead/window formulas now encode the holiday bound.

placement.why: Day classification and moving live in shared/schedules.ts, but the holiday-aware window size getWeekendMoveWindowDays is a private helper in schedules/app.ts next to the shared getDailyWeekendLookahead.

scope.why: Only the type field, rule data plumbing, the shared helpers, their callers and tests.

maintainability.why: Correct classification is centralised, but every caller must remember to pass holidays (defaults silently to []), so a new or missed call site would ignore holidays without any error.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend/holiday decisions go through isWeekendOrHoliday and getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated edits are plain parallel copies of pre-existing per-site filter/map code, not reshaped duplicates.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isWeekendOrHoliday defines what counts as a non-working day and is used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend and every daily-skip filter (getNextDate, schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange, via getNextDate in schedule-template); each path still has to thread config.holidays in explicitly.
